result.summary: Encoded the recorded Google image provider content-side stop truthfully into the E3 execution leg. exec-brain/e3_execution.py now separates three causes that were previously conflated under failure_attribution='verification_fail': provider_content_stop (decided only from the provider-returned finishReason in the provider's content-side set, or a promptFeedback block), provider_error (HTTP status, absent credential, raised adapter exception, or a 200 with no image and no content-side stop reason), and verification_fail (a delivered, well-formed output that fails its declared contract). Recovery for a content-side stop is a bounded identical same-request retry (same objective, same contract-declared shape; never a reworded repair) with DEFAULT_MAX_CONTENT_STOP_RETRIES=2, i.e. at most 3 identical single-shot calls per node; the bound is justified from the recorded series (two consecutive IMAGE_RECITATION stops at index 2-3 with the next identical call succeeding at index 4) and is stated as an inference, not a provider guarantee. The provider finishReason is recorded in the persisted DAG transition cause (provider_content_stop_unrecovered:<finishReason>), in blocking_reason, in the dispatch attempts and in the evidence row. An unrecovered stop terminates non-silently: node BLOCKED plus an E3 escalation (trigger=provider_content_stop) naming the finish reason and the owner decision; worker identity is never changed silently. A hard attempt bound (1 + max_repair_attempts + max_content_stop_retries) with a defensive attempt_budget_exhausted BLOCKED guard makes an unbounded retry impossible. Zero real provider calls: the recorded 2026-09-24T01:44:32Z responses are used verbatim as offline fixtures and the series was not re-run. The deterministic verification contract (only an independent verification PASS reaches COMPLETE) is unchanged, and E4 continuity / E5 repeated-failure convergence are confirmed unchanged. E3 Stage 2 remains disabled; no production dispatch, no VPS cutover, no readiness/qualification criterion changed.
